author: Destial
body:
Age: 14 this August 29
Timezone: SGT (UTC+08:00)
Do you have Teamspeak?: Yes but a little glitchy client-side and I have no microphone
Do you have Discord?: Yes but only I only answer to pings.
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes but it takes a lot of my space. 1min = 1gb


CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers?
Yes I have, I was a Head-Admin on a server but then it died because of inactivity. So I have plenty of experience in moderating and dealing with issues.

What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating?
My biggest weakness is that I am from a different timezone so I won't be able to be online if USA players are online at the time. For example, USA players are online at 12pm while I'm offline at 12am. (12 hour difference in New York)

What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not?
Qualities that a leader should have:
- Selfessness; not think of one-self but also think for others and the server.
- Loyalty; to be loyal to the server and never abandon it, even if it has gone inactive sometimes.
- Integrity; to always be honest and do the right things even when no one is watching/looking.
- Care; to care for the server and other players.
- Respect; respect towards other staff members and others' opinions of something/an issue.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
I can be very understanding when facing a certain issue and try to be as fair as possible. I also try to do a given task if possible. I am also online where most people are not so I can deal with Asian rule-breakers. (no racism intended)

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
Skills I believe I should have:
- Good communication; to be able to communicate fluently in a language(preferable English)
- Listening; to be able to understand and interpret what the player is speaking of
I do believe I have the skill of good communication but I am not sure if I have the skill of listening. I will try and see if I can aquire that skill.

What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?
Character traits a staff member should have:
- Sincerity; when conversing with other players
- Patience; not easily tempered when a player argues with a staff
- Persistence; to be determined to catch a player breaking a rule via recording software or screenshot
- Cooperative; be cooperative with other staff members if it is the right choice


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do?
Report it to a higher-ranking staff member. I would say, "I've noticed that {player} has been executing punishments with lack of evidence. If you would mind, could you kindly deal with him/her?" 

You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do?
I would say, "Hey now, don't be so rude. Sure some staff members have their mistakes and their faults, but that doesn't make them any different from you. You too have mistakes and opinions different to others. How would you feel if someone says something disrespectful to you? It will hurt your feelings. Try to be in (player)'s shoe."

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?
I would screenshot the evidence and report it to a higher-ranking staff member. I would politely ask the owner of the Discord channel to remove the screenshot.
I would tell the staff member who posted it, "Why'd you post that? That's against the rules. You should know that, as a staff member."

Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?
I would report this to an administrator with evidence. I may not have the right to tell the senior's what to do but I'll politely say, "This isn't a joking matter, please stop, it's making some players a bit furious."

CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.

Why do you want to be a moderator?
I want to be a moderator because I feel like there is not enough moderators that can take care of the timezone I am in. Only 2 staff members are somewhat near to my timezone. I also what to learn what it's like being a moderator and to strengthen my real-life skills in terms of communication and maturity.

What does Avicus mean to you?
Avicus means a lot to me, I sometimes get on even if no one is around, for example, 0 players online. Avicus is one of the only server's that I join because the rest are either boring or I am banned from. Avicus also lets me practise my PvP and scaffolding skills.

Anything specific the staff team could do better?
I guess to be more active? I am not to judge as I am not online regularly as well as others but I feel that I can help out with that "problem".

Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?
Avicus is the only server in which I have been very active on. So I feel that I know most of Avicus, if not some.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?
As I said at the beginning, I do not have a microphone, but I will buy one as soon as possible should I get accepted for the interview.

Thank you for reading my application.

Yours truly,
Destial
